markdown.title: The Elders Scrolls Online FAQ
markdown.content:
# What are the Sigil of the Alliance War Back Bling, Ebonheart Battleaxe Back Bling and Ebonheart Battleaxe Pickaxe?
The Sigil of the Alliance War Back Bling, Ebonheart Battleaxe Back Bling and Ebonheart Battleaxe Pickaxe are in-game cosmetics that you can use in Fortnite.

# How can I get the Sigil of the Alliance War Back Bling?
Any purchase of The Elder Scrolls Online on the Epic Game Store before July 20, 2024 11:00 am ET will grant you the Sigil of the Alliance War Back Bling in Fortnite. 

# How can I get the Ebonheart Battleaxe Back Bling/Pickaxe?
Any purchase of The Elder Scrolls Online: Necrom on the Epic Game Store starting July 20, 2023 11:00 am ET will grant you the Ebonheart Battleaxe Back Bling and Ebonheart Battleaxe Pickaxe in Fortnite. The Ebonheart Battleaxe Back Bling and Pickaxe will also be available for purchase in the Fortnite in-game Item Shop starting on July 20, 2023 at 8pm ET and ending on Aug 5, 2023, at 8pm ET.

# How do I get access to the Sigil of the Alliance War Back Bling, Ebonheart Battleaxe Back Bling or Ebonheart Battleaxe Pickaxe?
Once you have purchased The Elder Scrolls Online or The Elder Scrolls Online: Necrom on the Epic Games Store during the promotion period, log-in to Fortnite with the same Epic Games account and you will have the corresponding cosmetic automatically added to your Fortnite locker.

# If I purchase The Elder Scrolls Online on the Epic Games Store, will these cosmetic items also appear in my Fortnite locker on other platforms, like PlayStation®4, PlayStation®5, Xbox One™, Xbox Series X™, Xbox Series S™, Nintendo Switch™, PC, Android™?
Yes, if you are signed in with your Epic Games account or have linked your console account to your Epic Games account, you will have access to your cosmetic items on all linked platforms. Learn more about how to link your account at:
https://www.epicgames.com/help/epic-accounts-c74/connect-accounts-c110/how-do-i-link-my-console-account-to-my-epic-games-account-using-the-web-a3669

# What happens if I already purchased the Ebonheart Battleaxe Back Bling and Pickaxe in the Fortnite in-game shop and I then purchase The Elders Scrolls Online: Necrom through the Epic Games Store?
You will receive a grant inside Fortnite of 1200 V-Bucks instead of the Ebonheart Battleaxe Back Bling and Pickaxe.

# Do I get to keep the Sigil of the Alliance War Back Bling if I refund my purchase of The Elders Scrolls Online on the Epic Games Store?
No, if you refund your purchase of The Elder Scrolls Online on the Epic Games Store, you will lose your Sigil of the Alliance War Back Bling in Fortnite as well as any other benefits you may have received in connection with this promotion.

# Do I get to keep the Ebonheart Battleaxe Back Bling and Pickaxe if I refund my purchase of The Elders Scrolls Online: Necrom on the Epic Games Store?
No, if you refund your purchase of The Elders Scrolls Online: Necrom on the Epic Games Store, you will lose your Ebonheart Battleaxe Back Bling and Pickaxe in Fortnite as well as any other benefits you may have received in connection with this promotion

about.description:
Includes The Elder Scrolls Online base game plus the Morrowind, Imperial City, Orsinium, Thieves Guild, and Dark Brotherhood adventures.

Every legend starts somewhere and in The Elder Scrolls Online, it starts with you. Write your story into a vibrant chapter of Tamriel’s distant past that takes place nearly 1,000 years before the iconic TES V: Skyrim, and discover a world steeped in adventure and possibility.

# WELCOME TO SEASONS

Step into new stories and experimental content inspired by classic TES history, delivered every three months. Play and unlock epic rewards with Tamriel Tomes.

# A DIVERSE FANTASY WORLD

Travel Tamriel and discover a world of adventure. Explore mushroom forests in Morrowind, battle Daedra in Oblivion, or duel other players in PvP combat.

# RICH STORIES ON A SHARED CANVAS

Immerse yourself in storytelling crafted with the same spirit as your favorite Elder Scrolls games. Discover an ever-growing world with friends or solo.

# PURPOSE IN EVERY PATH

Choose from an array of quests and challenges that fit your desires and ambitions. Make this Elder Scrolls world your own - you belong here.
